item.title: Iran conflict highlights S. Korea's tech exposure in the Gulf
item.description: The US-Israeli strikes on Iran and the retaliatory attacks that have since hit Saudi Arabia, the UAE, Qatar, Kuwait and Bahrain are drawing attention to how much South Korea's biggest technology companies now have riding on the Gulf. item.description: LG AI Research, the conglomerate’s AI think tank, plans to unveil its latest multimodal large language model, Exaone 4.5, in the first half of this year, combining visual and linguistic intelligence as it aims to push its AI model toward global competitiveness. item.title: LG Energy Solution to exhibit AI, robotics, battery technologies at InterBattery 2026
item.description: LG Energy Solution said Monday it would showcase next-generation battery technologies spanning electric vehicles, energy storage systems and robotics at InterBattery 2026, the nation’s largest battery industry exhibition, to be held from Mar. 11-13 at Coex in Seoul. A key highlight is the debut of its lithium manganese-rich battery, aimed at improving the balance between cost competitiveness and performance. item.title: Middle East tensions raise supply stakes for Korea’s energy-heavy economy
item.description: South Korea has been thrust into crisis mode as coordinated US and Israeli strikes on Iran, which led to the death of Supreme Leader Ayatollah Ali Khamenei, have made the Strait of Hormuz a volatile flashpoint, sending oil prices higher and rattling industries dependent on the waterway. item.title: S. Korea, Singapore agree to launch FTA upgrade talks, expand nuclear energy cooperation
item.description: South Korea and Singapore agreed Monday to begin negotiations to upgrade their bilateral free trade agreement and deepen cooperation in nuclear energy, including small modular reactors, as the two countries seek to strengthen economic security amid growing global uncertainty. item.title: Gwangju–South Jeolla merger moves ahead despite snags
item.description: The planned integration of Gwangju and South Jeolla Province has entered a crucial phase following the National Assembly’s passage of a special merger support law, though several key issues remain unresolved ahead of the scheduled launch. The approval makes the southwestern region the only area in Korea where administrative integration talks are actively moving toward realization. item.title: KT unveils public, enterprise AI transformation at MWC
item.description: KT said Monday it will showcase its artificial intelligence transformation achievements at Mobile World Congress 2026 in Barcelona, Spain, highlighting its expansion into public and enterprise sectors. item.title: South Korean economy braces for Middle East fallout, banks step in
item.description: South Korea’s financial sector is preparing for potential fallout from escalating conflict in the Middle East, with major banking groups rolling out emergency support programs for companies exposed to rising geopolitical risks while authorities step up monitoring of financial markets. item.title: G-Dragon’s ‘Lunar New Year’ greeting at Dubai concert sparks controversy among Chinese fans
item.description: K-pop idols often find themselves at the center of controversies they did not necessarily intend to ignite. For global icons such as G-Dragon, even a brief remark onstage can reverberate far beyond its original context. During the Krazy Super Concert held Feb. 17 at Dubai Media City Amphitheater in the United Arab Emirates, G-Dragon greeted fans by saying “Lunar New Year” — a phrase that later drew backlash from some Chinese fans. item.description: LG Electronics said Monday it has joined the Global 6G Coalition launched by Qualcomm Technologies at Mobile World Congress 2026 in Barcelona, Spain, stepping up efforts to strengthen next-generation telematics capabilities.
